title: 01 / Find your way
goal: Search names and contents, then move through a visual file tree.
challenge: Find only Python files; search for alpha case-insensitively; open a result in your editor.

steps.title: Readable tree
steps.why: eza shows the small fixture tree.

steps.title: Name search
steps.why: fd searches names; ripgrep searches file contents.
steps.command: fd --extension py . source && rg -n alpha source

steps.title: Fuzzy selection
steps.why: Tab selects multiple files; Enter accepts.
steps.exit: Esc cancels; Enter prints your selection.

steps.title: Broot tree
steps.why: Search within the tree. The lab isolates broot configuration.

steps.title: Yazi manager
steps.why: Use j/k, Enter and parent navigation on disposable files.

title: 02 / Inspect text, JSON and bytes
goal: Choose a viewer that matches the data.
challenge: Locate the unhealthy service and identify the PNG file signature.

steps.title: Text preview
steps.why: bat adds syntax highlighting and line numbers.

steps.title: Hex view
steps.why: The PNG signature is visible in the first bytes.

steps.title: JSON tree
steps.why: Expand services, inspect booleans, search for worker.

steps.title: Wide-file pager
steps.why: Use a pager with structured-output navigation.

title: 03 / Make structured pipelines
goal: Parse supported command output with jc, then use jq and yq.
challenge: Change the jq filter to select unhealthy services and return their ports.

steps.title: CSV to JSON
steps.why: jc has parsers for many commands and file types.

steps.title: Filter JSON
steps.why: jq keeps structure while selecting records.

steps.title: JSON to YAML
steps.why: Mike Farah yq understands both formats.

steps.title: Simple replacement
steps.why: sd transforms stdin without modifying the source.

title: 04 / Copy, compress and compose
goal: Create archives, copy files and compose small UNIX pipeline helpers.
challenge: Compare the restored notes with the original; timestamp a pipeline with ts.

steps.title: Archive a directory
steps.why: ouch selects the format from the extension.
steps.command: ouch compress source bundle.tar.gz && ouch decompress bundle.tar.gz --dir restored

steps.title: Fast compression
steps.why: zstd keeps the source here; -f makes reruns safe.
steps.command: zstd -q -f source/notes.txt -o notes.zst && zstd -q -d -f notes.zst -o decoded.txt && cmp source/notes.txt decoded.txt

steps.title: Extended copy
steps.why: Copy only within the temporary workbook.
steps.command: xcp source/notes.txt copied.txt && cmp source/notes.txt copied.txt

steps.title: Safe in-place pipeline
steps.why: sponge reads input before opening the output file.
steps.command: cp source/notes.txt sorted.txt && sort -u sorted.txt | sponge sorted.txt && cat sorted.txt

steps.title: Timestamp lines
steps.why: ts is part of moreutils.

steps.title: Batch jobs
steps.why: Parallel runs independent jobs; --keep-order preserves input order.

steps.title: Edit directory entries
steps.why: vidir can rename/delete entries: only use the sample directory here.
steps.exit: Use :q! to leave without changes, or :wq to apply changes to the sample directory.

title: 05 / Understand disk usage
goal: Inspect size and duplicate content before deciding what to remove.
challenge: Find both duplicate files; do not delete them until you understand the report.

steps.title: Disk usage tree
steps.why: dust presents directory sizes.

steps.title: Filesystem overview
steps.why: duf shows capacity and mount points.

steps.title: Interactive usage
steps.why: dua provides navigation and explicit cleanup controls.

steps.title: Duplicate scan
steps.why: No deletion option is used. These are generated sample files.

title: 06 / Pictures and terminal color
goal: View a generated image and inspect color choices.
challenge: Try a smaller image width and choose an accent color you can read comfortably.

steps.title: Portable graphics
steps.why: chafa renders the image using terminal symbols.

steps.title: Image viewer
steps.why: viu uses the terminal graphics capabilities it detects.

steps.title: Color conversion
steps.why: pastel converts named colors into a portable hex value.

steps.title: Listing colors
steps.why: vivid generates LS_COLORS rules.

title: 07 / Learn without memorizing
goal: Use concise command examples, a readable pager and searchable help.
challenge: After running tldr --update outside the lab, compare tldr tar with tar --help.

steps.title: Tealdeer help
steps.why: The executable is tldr. Cache updates are explicit, not startup side effects.

steps.title: Discover jc parsers
steps.why: Read which outputs can be transformed before building pipelines.

steps.title: Explore archive options
steps.why: Read compression flags and supported formats.

title: 08 / Repeatable development loops
goal: Use task recipes, source counts, measurements and file watching.
challenge: Change the sample Python file and observe the watcher rerun.

steps.title: Task recipe
steps.why: just runs a named project command.

steps.title: Source statistics
steps.why: tokei counts the sample Python source.

steps.title: Measure a command
steps.why: Use repeated measurements rather than one wall-clock observation.

steps.title: Watch changes
steps.why: Open a second pane to edit source/demo.py while this runs.
steps.exit: Ctrl-c stops the watcher and returns to the workbook.

title: 09 / Build an operator deck
goal: Keep useful telemetry visible while leaving decorative effects optional.
challenge: Use dotfiles-style operator, restart Zsh, then launch dotfiles-deck outside the lab.

steps.title: System card
steps.why: fastfetch reports actual local machine information.

steps.title: Live monitor
steps.why: btop shows real resource usage.

steps.title: Digital rain
steps.why: This is a decorative effect, not monitoring or network activity.
steps.exit: Press q to leave the animation.

steps.title: Audio spectrum
steps.why: Cava requires an available audio capture source; WSL availability varies.
steps.exit: Ctrl-c returns; an unavailable audio source is not a dotfiles failure.
